# pvecli node vnc

Open authenticated VNC shell(s) for one or more nodes.

```text
pvecli node vnc [NODE] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node name(s) - single or comma-separated. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-b`, `--no-background` | Run VNC server in foreground (blocking, single node only). |
| `-s`, `--split` | Open each shell in a separate browser window instead of tabs. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
